title: ApiPeru
description: Unified lookups: one DNI or RUC opens the full file (identity, representatives, debts, finance…). Results open in a tabbed modal.

alert.token_body: Set {{env}} on the server to run lookups. The token is never exposed to the browser.
alert.ready_body: Each hub hits several ApiPerú sources. «X with error» is not a % on the RUC/DNI — it counts endpoints that failed (path, plan, or API down). Identity/general RUC can still be OK while another tab fails.
